title: Rabbit public-record source catalogs: archival provenance

totals_evidence: Rabbit1.txt declares the totals. SYS and AP heading totals were independently counted in Rabbit2.txt through Rabbit6.txt during recovery.
lineage: The text edition states it was generated on 2026-08-19 from 13aug2026_reconciled_investigative_api_catalogue.xlsx.
Rabbit1.txt through Rabbit6.txt were uploaded on 2026-08-21 and are individually byte-identical to the six investigative_api_catalogue_00–05 exports uploaded on 2026-08-19.
Six copies with (1) suffix were uploaded on 2026-09-17. Five are byte-identical duplicates. Rabbit2(1).txt was modified on 2026-09-23.

The September Rabbit2 update inserts a dated 223-line GSA/SAM review and changes one legacy investigative-relevance description. Its RAB-GSA-20260923-01–30 identifiers are local audit identifiers, not 30 newly allocated global source systems.
count_caveats: The 1,555 SYS records include active, partial, unverified and discovery-only entries. They are not 1,555 live-tested, free or unrestricted APIs.

The earlier catalog lineage is 158 sources (2026-08-05), 263 (2026-08-08), and 345 established sources plus three separate 300-row candidate-review layers in the Canada expansion workbook (declared expanded 2026-08-12). These are historical counts, not the size of the six Rabbit files.
The guide states 14aug26v1.xlsx was not incorporated because its ZIP container was truncated. That is a limitation stated by the original export, not a new repair or validation claim.
Source availability, prices, quotas, licenses and terms remain dated claims in the original records. Recovery does not revalidate every endpoint.

privacy_review.result: No live credentials, private contact details or URL-embedded authentication credentials found in the targeted review. API-key parameters are explicit placeholders; the sole email is researcher@example.org. The catalogs describe sensitive record categories but do not contain the underlying personal record datasets.
privacy_review.limitations: Pattern checks and contextual review are not a universal guarantee of absence. No endpoints were exercised with credentials.

authorship_and_reuse.provenance: The original six Rabbit files are byte-identical to earlier exports labeled model-generated in Library. The guide identifies the reconciled workbook as its source. No separate human byline or compilation-wide license was found.
authorship_and_reuse.publication_caution: This archive does not grant rights in third-party websites, documents or datasets. Entries have individual legal/reuse cautions. Before any public release, review compilation licensing and source-specific copyright, database rights, terms and personal-data restrictions. Do not apply a blanket code license to the source data by assumption.
